abstractEnglish: For a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite C∗-algebra with traces, real rank zero of the uniform tracial ultrapower of its uniform tracial completion implies uniform property Γ. This answers Problem XXI of Schafhauser, Tikuisis and White affirmatively. Independently, strict comparison implies Jiang–Su absorption for simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional nuclear algebras, resolving the unital Toms–Winter conjecture. Under comparison tested on traces of finite target rank, we also obtain uniform property Γ and absorption for simple, separable, nuclear, stably projectionless algebras whose densely finite traces are all bounded and have a nonempty compact normalized base.

details.overview: 该稿件讨论简单、可分、含单位、无限维、核、稳定有限的带迹C*代数。摘要称：其一致迹完备化的一致迹超幂若实秩为零，则蕴含一致性质Γ，从而肯定回答Schafhauser、Tikuisis与White的问题XXI；独立地，严格比较蕴含Jiang–Su吸收，解决含单位的Toms–Winter猜想；在有限目标秩迹上检验比较的条件下，还得到一类稳定无投影代数的一致性质Γ与吸收。摘要未给证明细节。需注意这是AI产生的研究手稿，收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
keyPoints: 一致迹超幂实秩为零蕴含一致性质Γ，回答Schafhauser–Tikuisis–White问题XXI。
严格比较蕴含Jiang–Su吸收，声称解决含单位Toms–Winter猜想。
对一类稳定无投影代数在附加比较条件下得到一致性质Γ与吸收。
